paragraphs: The Citan 110 CDI is the mid-range diesel option in the Mercedes Citan range, part of the W420 generation introduced in 2021. It uses the OM608 — a 1.5-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, developed as a collaboration between Mercedes and Renault, and shared across the commercial vehicle segment. The OM608 replaced the earlier Renault-sourced K9K unit used in the W415 generation (2012–2021), bringing updated emissions technology and improved efficiency. For owners of the current-generation Citan, this is the engine that balances power and economy for everyday commercial use.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every CITAN 110 CDI on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the CITAN 110 CDI from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
